name: Canyon Ranch Lenox
positioning: All-inclusive wellness resort on 120 wooded acres just outside Lenox in the Berkshires, built around the 1897 Bellefontaine Mansion
best_for: Travelers who want a spa-centered stay with daily classes and activities included
Guests who want to move between spa, fitness and dining indoors in winter

facts.text: The resort sits on 120 acres of wooded land just outside Lenox, Massachusetts.
The property is about one mile from downtown Lenox.
The grounds are anchored by Bellefontaine Mansion, built in 1897.
Long glass-enclosed corridors let guests move between rooms, dining, the spa and fitness facilities without going outdoors.
Treatment rooms, saunas, steam rooms and whirlpools are housed under one roof in the spa and fitness complex.
The spa menu has more than 150 treatments drawing on Eastern and Western traditions.
The resort offers more than 35 optional activities daily.
Swimming pools and aquatic activities are always included.
Unlimited meals, snacks and beverages at the on-site restaurants are included.
Tanglewood and The Mount are a short drive away.

highlights.text: Bellefontaine Mansion was inspired by the Petit Trianon at Versailles and later served as a Jesuit seminary.
The spa and wellness facilities span roughly 100,000 square feet.
The massage menu includes outdoor massages such as the Outdoor Open Sky Massage.
The corridors double as informal galleries lined with work by regional artists.
Rooms have large windows looking out onto trees and landscaped grounds.

considerations.text: Alcohol is available at dinner for an additional charge and is absent from daytime meals.
Private sessions, specialized consultations and select activities are priced a la carte unless bundled into a package or retreat.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the wellness focus.
